name: Priya Shah
summary: Data engineer with a Python-first toolkit, building reliable pipelines and analytical datasets for product and growth teams.

bullets: Built batch pipelines in Python using pandas and numpy for nightly metric refreshes.
Modeled warehouse tables in PostgreSQL and wrote SQL consumed by product dashboards.
Documented pipeline contracts and on-call runbooks for the analytics team.
Automated weekly Python reports, replacing a manual spreadsheet process.
Explored cohorts in Jupyter notebooks shared with marketing stakeholders.
